textos.titulo: A day in the life of a nurse
textos.texto: Ana is a nurse at a hospital in Recife. She starts work at 7 o'clock every day. She checks the patients and gives them their medicine. Her job is very tiring, but she loves it. She says that helping people is the best part of her day. After work, she likes to relax at home with her cat.

perguntas.pergunta: What time does Ana start work?
perguntas.evidencia: She starts work at 7 o'clock every day.
perguntas.explica: "Starts work at 7 o'clock" = começa a trabalhar às 7 horas.

perguntas.pergunta: Which sentence shows that Ana likes her job?
perguntas.evidencia: Her job is very tiring, but she loves it.
perguntas.explica: "She loves it" = ela ama o trabalho, mesmo sendo cansativo (tiring).

perguntas.pergunta: What does Ana do after work?
perguntas.evidencia: After work, she likes to relax at home with her cat.
perguntas.explica: "After work" = depois do trabalho: ela relaxa em casa com o gato.

textos.texto: Every year, millions of tons of plastic go into the oceans. Many sea animals, like turtles, think plastic bags are food. When they eat the plastic, they can get sick and die. We can help! Use reusable bags and bottles. Never throw trash on the beach.

perguntas.pergunta: Why do turtles eat plastic bags?
perguntas.explica: As tartarugas pensam que as sacolas são comida.

perguntas.pergunta: What happens when animals eat plastic?
perguntas.evidencia: they can get sick and die
perguntas.explica: "Get sick and die" = ficar doentes e morrer.

perguntas.pergunta: What can we use to help?
perguntas.explica: "Reusable" = reutilizável: sacolas e garrafas que usamos várias vezes.

textos.texto: My favorite holiday is Christmas. My whole family meets at my grandmother's house. We eat a lot of food, like rice, turkey and farofa. At midnight, we open the presents. Last year, I got a new bike! I can't wait for next December.

perguntas.evidencia: My whole family meets at my grandmother's house.
perguntas.explica: "At my grandmother's house" = na casa da minha avó.

perguntas.pergunta: What did the writer get last year?
perguntas.evidencia: Last year, I got a new bike!
perguntas.explica: "Got" é o passado de "get" (ganhar): ganhou uma bicicleta nova.

perguntas.pergunta: Which sentence shows that the writer is excited about next Christmas?
perguntas.evidencia: I can't wait for next December.
